name: Florian Müller
headline: Co-Founder, CTO at Lattice | CDTM | TUM

positions.title: Co-Founder, CTO
positions.description:
Lattice is building tools and infrastructure to make building complex, large-scale blockchain applications, such as games, virtual worlds, and social apps much, much easier.

We aim to take blockchain applications beyond finance and speculation. As our first market, we’re targeting fully on-chain games and autonomous virtual worlds, some of the most networking-intensive and complex applications that currently exist on the internet.

Specifically, we’re building MUD (https://mud.dev), our open-source framework for building large-scale blockchain applications, and our upcoming infrastructure-as-a-service designed specifically for MUD applications

Lattice also houses an in-house game studio designing and creating MUD-based autonomous virtual worlds, both as consumer-facing products and to push the boundaries of our technology.

positions.title: Founder

company.name: Lattice
company.description:
Lattice is building tools and infrastructure to make building ambitious, large-scale blockchain applications possible. Our goal is to take blockchain applications beyond just finance and speculation, to encompass playful use-cases such as games, virtual worlds, social apps, and P2P consumer apps. We want to transition Ethereum from a financial computer to its original ambition as the World Computer.

Specifically, we’re building MUD (https://mud.dev), an open-source framework for building large-scale blockchain applications, and are developing infrastructure products designed for MUD applications.

Lattice also houses an in-house game studio designing and creating MUD-based games and apps, both as consumer-facing products and to push the boundaries of our technology.
